venue.fullName: Tom Benson Hall of Fame Stadium

headlines.description: — Aaron Rodgers has yet to throw a pass in a game for the New York Jets. He's already responsible for a long completion.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wilson solid as a backup as Jets begin Rodgers Era with 21-16 loss to Browns in Hall of Fame game

events.name: Houston Texans at New England Patriots

headlines.description: — C.J. Stroud wouldn't change much about stepping on the field for the first time against an NFL opponent.
headlines.shortLinkText: No. 2 pick C.J. Stroud struggles in his preseason debut as the Texans beat the Patriots 20-9

headlines.shortLinkText: Drew Lock throws 2 touchdown passes to lead Seahawks to a 24-13 win over Vikings

events.name: Green Bay Packers at Cincinnati Bengals

headlines.description: — Jordan Love and Sean Clifford showed they can both move the Green Bay Packers' offense, at least in an early test against a leaky Cincinnati Bengals defense with few starters on the field.
headlines.shortLinkText: Love, Clifford help Packers roll past Bengals in preseason opener. Burrow watches from sideline

events.name: New York Giants at Detroit Lions

headlines.description: — Adrian Martinez scored on a 1-yard quarterback sneak with 1:51 left to give the Detroit Lions a 21-16 preseason victory over the New York Giants on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lions beat Giants 21-16 on undrafted rookie Adrian Martinez's late QB sneak

headlines.description: — Dee Alford played college football at a small school in Tusculum, Tennessee, and spent two years in the Canadian Football League before signing with the Atlanta Falcons last year. He didn’t even know at the time if he’d make the team’s 53-man roster.
headlines.shortLinkText: Alford's 79-yard punt return TD helps Falcons to a 19-3 win over Dolphins in preseason opener

events.name: Pittsburgh Steelers at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: — The Tampa Bay Buccaneers aren't rushing to declare a winner in the competition for Tom Brady's old job.

headlines.description: — Deshaun Watson feels like he's finally back to being himself.
headlines.shortLinkText: QBs Watson, Howell have solid starts, Brissett has TD run in Commanders' 17-15 win over Browns

headlines.description: — New Denver Broncos coach Sean Payton came out strong — possibly a little too strong — in support of his veteran quarterback earlier in training camp.
headlines.shortLinkText: Russell Wilson throws TD pass before Cardinals mount comeback to beat Broncos 18-17

headlines.shortLinkText: Colts QB Richardson struggles; Bills safety Hamlin shines in Buffalo's 23-19 preseason win

headlines.description: — Justin Fields insisted long completions are coming. For now, he'll take plays like these.

headlines.description: — Bryce Young's preseason debut didn't go exactly as planned.
headlines.shortLinkText: Panthers' Bryce Young limited to 21 yards in preseason debut as Jets win 27-0 without Aaron Rodgers

headlines.shortLinkText: Ridley has 2 catches in 1st game in almost 2 years as Jags get 28-23 preseason win over Cowboys

headlines.shortLinkText: Ravens hold off Eagles 20-19 for 24th consecutive preseason victory

headlines.shortLinkText: Stetson Bennett gets his first NFL action for the Rams in a 34-17 preseason loss to the Chargers

events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at New Orleans Saints

events.name: San Francisco 49ers at Las Vegas Raiders

headlines.description: — Philadelphia Eagles quarterback Jalen Hurts and Cleveland Browns counterpart Deshaun Watson watched in street clothes on the sidelines as their potential backups struggled in preseason game marred by injuries.
headlines.shortLinkText: Backups Mariota, Thompson-Robinson struggle as starters rest in Eagles-Browns 18-18 preseason tie

events.name: Carolina Panthers at New York Giants

headlines.description: — The way Daniel Jones played in his preseason debut, it looks as if the New York Giants got a steal signing him to a $160 million contract in March.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jones plays like $40 million man for Giants, No. 1 overall Young shows flashes for Panthers

headlines.description: — Desmond Ridder and all those young offensive weapons gave a glimpse of what they they can do for the Atlanta Falcons.
headlines.shortLinkText: QB Desmond Ridder impressive in preseason debut, Falcons settle for 13-13 tie with Bengals

headlines.shortLinkText: Tagovailoa leads TD drive in preseason debut to help Dolphins over Texans 28-3

headlines.description: — The Pittsburgh Steelers spent all of the spring and most of the summer talking about building an offense capable of big plays, the kind they've been lacking for large swaths of the past few seasons.
headlines.shortLinkText: Steelers display big-play ability as Pickett, Warren shine in 27-15 preseason victory over Bills

headlines.description: — Anthony Richardson's home debut was put on hold Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Richardson, Fields sit out as Ehlinger rallies Colts past Bears, 24-17

events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at New York Jets

headlines.description: — The Tampa Bay Buccaneers' quarterback competition appeared to become a bit clearer when Baker Mayfield never left the sideline against the New York Jets.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mayfield sits while Trask plays in Bucs' 13-6 preseason win over Jets. Backup Wolford injures neck

events.name: New England Patriots at Green Bay Packers

headlines.description: — Malik Willis rushed for 91 yards and threw a touchdown pass while playing the entire game for Tennessee, and the Titans dominated at the line of scrimmage in a 24-16 preseason victory over the Minnesota Vikings on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Titans trample the Vikings in a 24-16 preseason victory with 281 rushing yards

events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at Arizona Cardinals

headlines.description: — Kansas City's first-team offense didn't play well during its first few series Saturday night, dropping a few passes, committing a few penalties and coming up well short of the end zone.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mahomes throws a touchdown pass as Chiefs roll to 38-10 preseason win over the Cardinals

headlines.description: — Trey Lance and Jake Moody got some vindication on the final drive for the San Francisco 49ers.
headlines.shortLinkText: 49ers rally late behind Trey Lance to beat Broncos 21-20 on rookie Jake Moody's kick

events.name: Las Vegas Raiders at Los Angeles Rams

headlines.description: — Jimmy Garoppolo wanted a chance to lead the Las Vegas Raiders before the games that count, and Josh McDaniels was happy to give it to him.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jimmy Garoppolo looks sharp in his Raiders debut, and Vegas beats the Rams 34-17

headlines.description: — Geno Smith looked sharp in his two drives, Drew Lock led Seattle to a pair of second-quarter touchdowns, and the Seahawks beat the Dallas Cowboys 22-14 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Seahawks starters look sharp in limited action, Seattle tops Dallas 22-14

events.name: New Orleans Saints at Los Angeles Chargers

headlines.description: — One might think Dennis Allen would be relatively happy that his New Orleans Saints had two good days of work against the Los Angeles Chargers and then won Sunday's preseason game 22-17.
headlines.shortLinkText: Winston directs 3 scoring drives as Saints hold on for 22-17 victory over Chargers

headlines.description: — Sam Howell was still in middle school the last time the Baltimore Ravens had lost a preseason game.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ravens' NFL-record preseason winning streak ends at 24 with a loss to the Commanders

headlines.description: — Mike Tomlin didn't waver in his decision to play quarterback Kenny Pickett and other Pittsburgh starters even when Atlanta coach Arthur Smith countered with his backups.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kenny Pickett and the Steelers' starters cap an impressive preseason in a win over the Falcons

headlines.description: — Indianapolis rookie quarterback Anthony Richardson displayed flashes of promise but also showed that there's much work to do, helping the Colts beat the Philadelphia Eagles 27-13 on Thursday night in the preseason finale for each team.
headlines.shortLinkText: Colts rookie QB Richardson has mixed performance in preseason victory over Eagles

headlines.description: — Bryce Young certainly looks ready for the regular season as a passer.
headlines.shortLinkText: No. 1 pick Bryce Young looks sharp, throws first TD pass in final tuneup for regular season

events.name: New England Patriots at Tennessee Titans

headlines.description: — Mike Vrabel wants to see his Tennessee Titans start faster, especially now that the preseason is over.
headlines.shortLinkText: Malik Willis throws for 2 TDs as Titans wrap preseason beating Pats 23-7

events.name: Los Angeles Chargers at San Francisco 49ers

headlines.shortLinkText: Purdy runs for a TD before Chargers backups roll past 49ers 23-12

headlines.description: — Josh Allen pronounced himself ready for the regular season, and Kyle Allen made a strong statement about why he should be the Buffalo Bills' backup quarterback.
headlines.shortLinkText: QBs Josh Allen, Kyle Allen spark Bills to 24-21 win over Bears in preseason finale

events.name: Seattle Seahawks at Green Bay Packers

headlines.description: — Jordan Love ended the preseason the way he wanted as he gets ready for the challenge of taking over for a four-time MVP.
headlines.shortLinkText: Love connects with Watson on TD pass as Packers close preseason with 19-15 victory over Seahawks

events.name: Cleveland Browns at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: — Deshaun Watson acknowledged there is plenty to fix with about two weeks left before the start of the season, but the Browns quarterback also has seen some progress and believes things are trending in the right direction.
headlines.shortLinkText: Deshaun Watson leads the Browns to a pair of TDs in a 33-32 preseason loss to the Chiefs

headlines.description: — David Blough had a touchdown pass and a rushing score in a second-half rally by the Arizona Cardinals to beat the Minnesota Vikings 18-17 in their final preseason game on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: David Blough rallies Cardinals to an 18-17 victory over Vikings in the teams' preseason finale

events.name: New York Jets at New York Giants

headlines.description: — Aaron Rodgers shook off the rust, threw a few passes and led the New York Jets into the end zone.
headlines.shortLinkText: Aaron Rodgers throws a TD pass in his brief preseason debut as Jets beat Giants 32-24

headlines.description: — Jake Browning knows it's not his job to name himself Joe Burrow's backup — or potentially the Week 1 starter if the Cincinnati Bengals' <a...
headlines.shortLinkText: Browning makes a case to back up Burrow with his play in the Bengals' preseason finale at Washington

events.name: Baltimore Ravens at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: — Baker Mayfield looked comfortable in his final tuneup as Tampa Bay’s new starting quarterback, throwing a touchdown pass while playing less than a quarter in the Buccaneers’ 26-20 preseason-closing victory over the Baltimore Ravens on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mayfield shines in final tuneup for regular season; Buccaneers hold off Ravens 26-20

headlines.description: — Miami Dolphins wide receiver Daewood Davis was carted off the field in an immobilized position after a collision in the fourth quarter of a preseason game against the Jacksonville Jaguars on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Daewood Davis of Dolphins carted off field after collision; preseason game vs. Jaguars halted

events.name: Las Vegas Raiders at Dallas Cowboys

headlines.description: — Will Grier looked and sounded as if his last act with these Dallas Cowboys was throwing for 305 yards with star quarterback Dak Prescott as his play-caller.
headlines.shortLinkText: Grier shines in possible final act with team as Cowboys beat Raiders 31-16 in preseason finale
